title: CRISPRi growth and essentiality
description: 820 real guides: all guides targeting the first 20 named genes in the published depletion-sorted table, plus every 150th table row. Full table has 59246 guides.
reference: K-12 MG1655, growth-based screen in strain LC-E75; original published genome positions
coordinateSystem: Original table gene_left/gene_right and guide position; coordinate base not independently established. Preserve as published.
processing: Read the published S1 CSV. No renormalization. Select all guides for first 20 distinct named genes in depletion-sorted source plus a systematic 1-in-150 row sample; no fabricated positions.
limits: Subset is deliberately enriched for depleted guides and is not representative of the full effect distribution.
Essentiality category is supplied by the paper, not independently inferred.
Coordinates are retained exactly from source; avoid cross-build alignment claims.
